name: UHP Technologies Pvt Ltd
capabilities: Turnkey Engineering Solution for Clean Rooms
Ultra High Purity Gases & Chemicals Delivery Systems
india_angle: UHP Technologies Pvt Ltd has a significant presence in India with offices in Bengaluru and Navi Mumbai, focusing on engineering solutions.
summary: UHP Technologies Pvt Ltd specializes in providing turnkey engineering solutions for clean rooms and high purity gas and chemical delivery systems, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing facilities. Their expertise extends to designing and implementing DI water transfer systems, supporting various high-tech industries including semiconductors.
